meta.title: Awakening and Reunion
meta.description: Master, it is an honor to fight by your side once again.

units.rawText: The bell tolls for a new day.
units.displayText: The bell tolls for a new day.

spans.text: The bell tolls for a new day.

units.rawText: After several days of intense fighting, the enemies within the city have finally surrendered. Victory broadcasts fill the streets, and a familiar folk song once again plays in the city square.
units.displayText: After several days of intense fighting, the enemies within the city have finally surrendered. Victory broadcasts fill the streets, and a familiar folk song once again plays in the city square.

spans.text: After several days of intense fighting, the enemies within the city have finally surrendered. Victory broadcasts fill the streets, and a familiar folk song once again plays in the city square.

units.rawText: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield; where do you rest now?
units.displayText: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield; where do you rest now?

spans.text: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield; where do you rest now?

units.rawText: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.
units.displayText: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

spans.text: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

units.rawText: The fires of war have burned out. Lieutenant Izka's body receives a proper burial, and the soldiers form ranks in the cemetery to send off their fallen comrades and lower the curtains on this tragedy.
units.displayText: The fires of war have burned out. Lieutenant Izka's body receives a proper burial, and the soldiers form ranks in the cemetery to send off their fallen comrades and lower the curtains on this tragedy.

spans.text: The fires of war have burned out. Lieutenant Izka's body receives a proper burial, and the soldiers form ranks in the cemetery to send off their fallen comrades and lower the curtains on this tragedy.

units.rawText: The city has experienced much pain, but now it will recover amidst the stability and peace, and someday it will regain its past splendor.
units.displayText: The city has experienced much pain, but now it will recover amidst the stability and peace, and someday it will regain its past splendor.

spans.text: The city has experienced much pain, but now it will recover amidst the stability and peace, and someday it will regain its past splendor.

units.rawText: We've found three of the 12 missing Dolls from the special intelligence team. They will rejoin the unit after they are repaired, and you will receive nine new recruits for your unit.
units.displayText: We've found three of the 12 missing Dolls from the special intelligence team. They will rejoin the unit after they are repaired, and you will receive nine new recruits for your unit.

spans.text: We've found three of the 12 missing Dolls from the special intelligence team. They will rejoin the unit after they are repaired, and you will receive nine new recruits for your unit.

units.rawText: This battle was really hard on our Dolls. We're lucky that three survived.
units.displayText: This battle was really hard on our Dolls. We're lucky that three survived.

spans.text: This battle was really hard on our Dolls. We're lucky that three survived.

units.rawText: What about you, Big Sis Centaureissi? You must have taken a lot of damage in the fighting too, right? When will you get repaired?
units.displayText: What about you, Big Sis Centaureissi? You must have taken a lot of damage in the fighting too, right? When will you get repaired?

spans.text: What about you, Big Sis Centaureissi? You must have taken a lot of damage in the fighting too, right? When will you get repaired?

units.rawText: Don't worry, Chris. I've already contacted UAS customer service. Now that the roads to the city have been reopened, the Doll pickup vehicle will arrive today.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Chris. I've already contacted UAS customer service. Now that the roads to the city have been reopened, the Doll pickup vehicle will arrive today.

spans.text: Don't worry, Chris. I've already contacted UAS customer service. Now that the roads to the city have been reopened, the Doll pickup vehicle will arrive today.

units.rawText: So you're leaving already, Big Sis?
units.displayText: So you're leaving already, Big Sis?

spans.text: So you're leaving already, Big Sis?

units.rawText: Chris' eyes moisten with tears. Centaureissi bends down and hugs her in consolation.
units.displayText: Chris' eyes moisten with tears. Centaureissi bends down and hugs her in consolation.

spans.text: Chris' eyes moisten with tears. Centaureissi bends down and hugs her in consolation.

units.rawText: Be strong, Chris. Goodbyes aren't forever. Perhaps we'll meet again in some faraway place when you grow up.
units.displayText: Be strong, Chris. Goodbyes aren't forever. Perhaps we'll meet again in some faraway place when you grow up.

spans.text: Be strong, Chris. Goodbyes aren't forever. Perhaps we'll meet again in some faraway place when you grow up.

units.rawText: Meeting each other is a miracle. After all, it left us with this bond. No matter where you go, I will always be thinking of you.
units.displayText: Meeting each other is a miracle. After all, it left us with this bond. No matter where you go, I will always be thinking of you.

spans.text: Meeting each other is a miracle. After all, it left us with this bond. No matter where you go, I will always be thinking of you.

units.rawText: Yeah... I'll think of you too, Big Sis...
units.displayText: Yeah... I'll think of you too, Big Sis...

spans.text: Yeah... I'll think of you too, Big Sis...

units.rawText: I help wipe Chris' tears away and ruffle her hair affectionately.
units.displayText: I help wipe Chris' tears away and ruffle her hair affectionately.

spans.text: I help wipe Chris' tears away and ruffle her hair affectionately.

units.rawText: You're not a crybaby, right? I still remember how you came to rescue us with the reinforcement troops. You're our savior.
units.displayText: You're not a crybaby, right? I still remember how you came to rescue us with the reinforcement troops. You're our savior.

spans.text: You're not a crybaby, right? I still remember how you came to rescue us with the reinforcement troops. You're our savior.

units.rawText: Commander... Were you happy with how I did?
units.displayText: Commander... Were you happy with how I did?

spans.text: Commander... Were you happy with how I did?

units.rawText: Of course. You did very well in this battle, and your father would have been proud.
units.displayText: Of course. You did very well in this battle, and your father would have been proud.

spans.text: Of course. You did very well in this battle, and your father would have been proud.

units.rawText: All birds must leave the nest someday, when their wings grow full and strong. May you soar in skies free of war. That is our wish, as well as your father's.
units.displayText: All birds must leave the nest someday, when their wings grow full and strong. May you soar in skies free of war. That is our wish, as well as your father's.

spans.text: All birds must leave the nest someday, when their wings grow full and strong. May you soar in skies free of war. That is our wish, as well as your father's.

units.rawText: After bidding us farewell, Chris heads back to the city with Lieutenant Izka's comrades. There, she will go to a good school and leave a safe and happy life, just as her father wanted.
units.displayText: After bidding us farewell, Chris heads back to the city with Lieutenant Izka's comrades. There, she will go to a good school and leave a safe and happy life, just as her father wanted.

spans.text: After bidding us farewell, Chris heads back to the city with Lieutenant Izka's comrades. There, she will go to a good school and leave a safe and happy life, just as her father wanted.

units.rawText: As I watch Chris leave, I suddenly remember something.
units.displayText: As I watch Chris leave, I suddenly remember something.

spans.text: As I watch Chris leave, I suddenly remember something.

units.rawText: Oh yes, there's one other thing.
units.displayText: Oh yes, there's one other thing.

spans.text: Oh yes, there's one other thing.

units.rawText: I dial the intel center manager on my communicator.
units.displayText: I dial the intel center manager on my communicator.

spans.text: I dial the intel center manager on my communicator.

units.rawText: Greetings. How may I help you today?
units.displayText: Greetings. How may I help you today?

spans.text: Greetings. How may I help you today?

units.rawText: Greetings, Miss. I'm the commander of the special intelligence team, and I'd like you to put me through to Messenger Pigeon 36 of the intel branch.
units.displayText: Greetings, Miss. I'm the commander of the special intelligence team, and I'd like you to put me through to Messenger Pigeon 36 of the intel branch.

spans.text: Greetings, Miss. I'm the commander of the special intelligence team, and I'd like you to put me through to Messenger Pigeon 36 of the intel branch.

units.rawText: Now transferring you to operative No. 36. Please hold.
units.displayText: Now transferring you to operative No. 36. Please hold.

spans.text: Now transferring you to operative No. 36. Please hold.

units.rawText: Commander, you...
units.displayText: Commander, you...

spans.text: Commander, you...

units.rawText: I take off my ear mike and hand it to Centaureissi with a nod.
units.displayText: I take off my ear mike and hand it to Centaureissi with a nod.

spans.text: I take off my ear mike and hand it to Centaureissi with a nod.

units.rawText: War has broken up too many families—it's hard to find one's kin in the gunsmoke it leaves behind. As a member of the special intelligence team, I would like you to be reunited with your family.
units.displayText: War has broken up too many families—it's hard to find one's kin in the gunsmoke it leaves behind. As a member of the special intelligence team, I would like you to be reunited with your family.

spans.text: War has broken up too many families—it's hard to find one's kin in the gunsmoke it leaves behind. As a member of the special intelligence team, I would like you to be reunited with your family.

units.rawText: There was no need for that. Using your authority to contact an intelligence operative for the sake of my personal feelings is technically a violation of military regulations.
units.displayText: There was no need for that. Using your authority to contact an intelligence operative for the sake of my personal feelings is technically a violation of military regulations.

spans.text: There was no need for that. Using your authority to contact an intelligence operative for the sake of my personal feelings is technically a violation of military regulations.

units.rawText: You've grown kinder after experiencing so much, but you're still as stern as ever.
units.displayText: You've grown kinder after experiencing so much, but you're still as stern as ever.

spans.text: You've grown kinder after experiencing so much, but you're still as stern as ever.

units.rawText: Well then, think of it as thanks for saving me so many times.
units.displayText: Well then, think of it as thanks for saving me so many times.

spans.text: Well then, think of it as thanks for saving me so many times.

units.rawText: Centaureissi bites her lip and takes the ear mike from me. A gentle female voice speaks to her over the radio waves.
units.displayText: Centaureissi bites her lip and takes the ear mike from me. A gentle female voice speaks to her over the radio waves.

spans.text: Centaureissi bites her lip and takes the ear mike from me. A gentle female voice speaks to her over the radio waves.

units.rawText: Greetings, Commander.
units.displayText: Greetings, Commander.

spans.text: Greetings, Commander.

units.rawText: Um... It's me, Centaureissi, the Doll temporarily attached to the special intelligence team.
units.displayText: Um... It's me, Centaureissi, the Doll temporarily attached to the special intelligence team.

spans.text: Um... It's me, Centaureissi, the Doll temporarily attached to the special intelligence team.

units.rawText: Greetings, Centaureissi. Thank you for your help in the previous operation. You and the Commander executed a flawless infiltration of the enemy base and caused havoc there.
units.displayText: Greetings, Centaureissi. Thank you for your help in the previous operation. You and the Commander executed a flawless infiltration of the enemy base and caused havoc there.

spans.text: Greetings, Centaureissi. Thank you for your help in the previous operation. You and the Commander executed a flawless infiltration of the enemy base and caused havoc there.

units.rawText: Because of your efforts, the battle to eliminate the enemy from the city was a success.
units.displayText: Because of your efforts, the battle to eliminate the enemy from the city was a success.

spans.text: Because of your efforts, the battle to eliminate the enemy from the city was a success.

units.rawText: Her words do not seem to indicate any recognition of the name Centaureissi and a sheen of dejection falls over the Doll's eyes.
units.displayText: Her words do not seem to indicate any recognition of the name Centaureissi and a sheen of dejection falls over the Doll's eyes.

spans.text: Her words do not seem to indicate any recognition of the name Centaureissi and a sheen of dejection falls over the Doll's eyes.

units.rawText: Thank you for your praise. In truth, your voice reminds me of my little sister, Vayne. I mistook you for her.
units.displayText: Thank you for your praise. In truth, your voice reminds me of my little sister, Vayne. I mistook you for her.

spans.text: Thank you for your praise. In truth, your voice reminds me of my little sister, Vayne. I mistook you for her.

units.rawText: Hehe, does it?
units.displayText: Hehe, does it?

spans.text: Hehe, does it?

units.rawText: There are many people with similar voices in the world. I guess I must have been imagining things.
units.displayText: There are many people with similar voices in the world. I guess I must have been imagining things.

spans.text: There are many people with similar voices in the world. I guess I must have been imagining things.

units.rawText: You weren't imagining things. Many people have said my voice sounds like hers.
units.displayText: You weren't imagining things. Many people have said my voice sounds like hers.

spans.text: You weren't imagining things. Many people have said my voice sounds like hers.

units.rawText: Wait, you know Vayne?
units.displayText: Wait, you know Vayne?

spans.text: Wait, you know Vayne?

units.rawText: Yes, I do, But I don't know if she's the person you're looking for. She was born in a military household and joined the army after graduating from a military academy.
units.displayText: Yes, I do, But I don't know if she's the person you're looking for. She was born in a military household and joined the army after graduating from a military academy.

spans.text: Yes, I do, But I don't know if she's the person you're looking for. She was born in a military household and joined the army after graduating from a military academy.

units.rawText: She was an intelligence operative like me, but unlike me, she was a strong, fiery lass.
units.displayText: She was an intelligence operative like me, but unlike me, she was a strong, fiery lass.

spans.text: She was an intelligence operative like me, but unlike me, she was a strong, fiery lass.

units.rawText: I, on the other hand, was weak and timid, and the loss of my parents only made it worse—to the point where I spent all day crying. Vayne went out of her way to befriend me and passed down a lot of military knowledge and operational experience to me.
units.displayText: I, on the other hand, was weak and timid, and the loss of my parents only made it worse—to the point where I spent all day crying. Vayne went out of her way to befriend me and passed down a lot of military knowledge and operational experience to me.

spans.text: I, on the other hand, was weak and timid, and the loss of my parents only made it worse—to the point where I spent all day crying. Vayne went out of her way to befriend me and passed down a lot of military knowledge and operational experience to me.

units.rawText: I was tormented by nightmares after watching my parents being killed by the enemy and Vayne would sing me to sleep.
units.displayText: I was tormented by nightmares after watching my parents being killed by the enemy and Vayne would sing me to sleep.

spans.text: I was tormented by nightmares after watching my parents being killed by the enemy and Vayne would sing me to sleep.

units.rawText: Do you know where Vayne is now?
units.displayText: Do you know where Vayne is now?

spans.text: Do you know where Vayne is now?

units.rawText: After the fighting reached this city, I stayed behind to serve as an intelligence operator for the garrison troops, while she was transferred to another city to serve on the frontlines.
units.displayText: After the fighting reached this city, I stayed behind to serve as an intelligence operator for the garrison troops, while she was transferred to another city to serve on the frontlines.

spans.text: After the fighting reached this city, I stayed behind to serve as an intelligence operator for the garrison troops, while she was transferred to another city to serve on the frontlines.

units.rawText: So she's no longer here...
units.displayText: So she's no longer here...

spans.text: So she's no longer here...

units.rawText: That form which seemed almost within reach fades away like an evanescent dream, scattered by a warm spring breeze. The disappointment within her takes the form of a quiet sigh.
units.displayText: That form which seemed almost within reach fades away like an evanescent dream, scattered by a warm spring breeze. The disappointment within her takes the form of a quiet sigh.

spans.text: That form which seemed almost within reach fades away like an evanescent dream, scattered by a warm spring breeze. The disappointment within her takes the form of a quiet sigh.

units.rawText: However, she mentioned you to me before. She said...
units.displayText: However, she mentioned you to me before. She said...

spans.text: However, she mentioned you to me before. She said...

units.rawText: While she did not want you to go to the battlefield, she wanted to meet you again, just like in the song—
units.displayText: While she did not want you to go to the battlefield, she wanted to meet you again, just like in the song—

spans.text: While she did not want you to go to the battlefield, she wanted to meet you again, just like in the song—

units.rawText: <color=orange>May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.</color>
units.displayText: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.

spans.text: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.

units.rawText: <color=orange>May the fires have burned out when we meet again.</color>
units.displayText: May the fires have burned out when we meet again.

spans.text: May the fires have burned out when we meet again.

units.rawText: The song in the ear-mike strums the strings of the blonde girl's heart.
units.displayText: The song in the ear-mike strums the strings of the blonde girl's heart.

spans.text: The song in the ear-mike strums the strings of the blonde girl's heart.

units.rawText: She has a similar position, a similar voice, and even a heart that longs for peace, just like her. Centaureissi knows that the person on the other side of the line is not Vayne.
units.displayText: She has a similar position, a similar voice, and even a heart that longs for peace, just like her. Centaureissi knows that the person on the other side of the line is not Vayne.

spans.text: She has a similar position, a similar voice, and even a heart that longs for peace, just like her. Centaureissi knows that the person on the other side of the line is not Vayne.

units.rawText: But there are countless others out there trying to protect peace on the battlefield. Who's to say they're not all Vayne?
units.displayText: But there are countless others out there trying to protect peace on the battlefield. Who's to say they're not all Vayne?

spans.text: But there are countless others out there trying to protect peace on the battlefield. Who's to say they're not all Vayne?

units.rawText: Their hearts are loyal, just like her. They long for peace, just like her. They're willing to spread their wings and protect the innocent from harm, just like her.
units.displayText: Their hearts are loyal, just like her. They long for peace, just like her. They're willing to spread their wings and protect the innocent from harm, just like her.

spans.text: Their hearts are loyal, just like her. They long for peace, just like her. They're willing to spread their wings and protect the innocent from harm, just like her.

units.rawText: The country is still embroiled in war and Vayne's mission is not yet over.
units.displayText: The country is still embroiled in war and Vayne's mission is not yet over.

spans.text: The country is still embroiled in war and Vayne's mission is not yet over.

units.rawText: How could I fail to understand her feelings...
units.displayText: How could I fail to understand her feelings...

spans.text: How could I fail to understand her feelings...

units.rawText: I'll be enlisting tomorrow. Long hair is going to get in the way, so I want to trim it to look cool and efficient.
units.displayText: I'll be enlisting tomorrow. Long hair is going to get in the way, so I want to trim it to look cool and efficient.

spans.text: I'll be enlisting tomorrow. Long hair is going to get in the way, so I want to trim it to look cool and efficient.

units.rawText: You're enlisting? But you live in a peaceful place; you can eat your fill here and you can enjoy a comfortable life.
units.displayText: You're enlisting? But you live in a peaceful place; you can eat your fill here and you can enjoy a comfortable life.

spans.text: You're enlisting? But you live in a peaceful place; you can eat your fill here and you can enjoy a comfortable life.

units.rawText: The situation on the frontline is urgent—there are countless people out there looking for our help who have suffered the ravages of war with no homes and nothing to eat.
units.displayText: The situation on the frontline is urgent—there are countless people out there looking for our help who have suffered the ravages of war with no homes and nothing to eat.

spans.text: The situation on the frontline is urgent—there are countless people out there looking for our help who have suffered the ravages of war with no homes and nothing to eat.

units.rawText: I was born in a military household, and I have a military bloodline. It only makes sense that I offer up my strength to help protect them.
units.displayText: I was born in a military household, and I have a military bloodline. It only makes sense that I offer up my strength to help protect them.

spans.text: I was born in a military household, and I have a military bloodline. It only makes sense that I offer up my strength to help protect them.

units.rawText: I'm not a kid anymore, Centaureissi. My wings are strong now, so I want to use them to protect everyone...
units.displayText: I'm not a kid anymore, Centaureissi. My wings are strong now, so I want to use them to protect everyone...

spans.text: I'm not a kid anymore, Centaureissi. My wings are strong now, so I want to use them to protect everyone...

units.rawText: Yes, she was Vayne, so gentle, yet so strong from a young age, the Vayne who felt for the people around her.
units.displayText: Yes, she was Vayne, so gentle, yet so strong from a young age, the Vayne who felt for the people around her.

spans.text: Yes, she was Vayne, so gentle, yet so strong from a young age, the Vayne who felt for the people around her.

units.rawText: I never understood why Vayne would abandon her comfortable life for the fires of the battlefield.
units.displayText: I never understood why Vayne would abandon her comfortable life for the fires of the battlefield.

spans.text: I never understood why Vayne would abandon her comfortable life for the fires of the battlefield.

units.rawText: Centaureissi mutters to herself, then she suddenly jerks her head up with a smile, as though she's made up her mind.
units.displayText: Centaureissi mutters to herself, then she suddenly jerks her head up with a smile, as though she's made up her mind.

spans.text: Centaureissi mutters to herself, then she suddenly jerks her head up with a smile, as though she's made up her mind.

units.rawText: But I understand now.
units.displayText: But I understand now.

spans.text: But I understand now.

units.rawText: However weak or insignificant or flimsy her wings might be, she wanted to use them to shelter the people caught up in war.
units.displayText: However weak or insignificant or flimsy her wings might be, she wanted to use them to shelter the people caught up in war.

spans.text: However weak or insignificant or flimsy her wings might be, she wanted to use them to shelter the people caught up in war.

units.rawText: Vayne never changed, not for a moment.
units.displayText: Vayne never changed, not for a moment.

spans.text: Vayne never changed, not for a moment.

units.rawText: Thank you, Messenger Pigeon 36.
units.displayText: Thank you, Messenger Pigeon 36.

spans.text: Thank you, Messenger Pigeon 36.

units.rawText: You're welcome. I am happy to have helped you and the Commander.
units.displayText: You're welcome. I am happy to have helped you and the Commander.

spans.text: You're welcome. I am happy to have helped you and the Commander.

units.rawText: The girl hangs up as the gentle wind caresses her long hair and she sweeps several strands behind her ear. She looks just like how she first appeared when I came to this war-torn city— gentle, strong, immaculate.
units.displayText: The girl hangs up as the gentle wind caresses her long hair and she sweeps several strands behind her ear. She looks just like how she first appeared when I came to this war-torn city— gentle, strong, immaculate.

units.rawText: And now that her wings have been tempered and unbound by a baptism of fire, she can hold up the sky for more people now.

units.displayText: Beep-beep—

spans.text: Beep-beep—

units.rawText: The Doll recovery vehicle drives up from the distance, coming to a halt in front of us. An efficient-looking service Doll dismounts and approaches us.
units.displayText: The Doll recovery vehicle drives up from the distance, coming to a halt in front of us. An efficient-looking service Doll dismounts and approaches us.

spans.text: The Doll recovery vehicle drives up from the distance, coming to a halt in front of us. An efficient-looking service Doll dismounts and approaches us.

units.displayText: Greetings. I am a Doll recovery operator from Universal Anything Services.

spans.text: Greetings. I am a Doll recovery operator from Universal Anything Services.

units.displayText: Please verify the information on this recovery form.

units.displayText: Are you the Commander of the special intelligence team?

units.rawText: Indeed.
units.displayText: Indeed.

units.displayText: An ownerless Doll we took in earlier requested to be transferred to you.

spans.text: An ownerless Doll we took in earlier requested to be transferred to you.

units.displayText: Him? Do I know him?

units.displayText: Yes. I hope you are prepared for this.

units.rawText: When I fainted that day, was it really due to overwork? Was everything that happened on the battlefield just a dream?

units.rawText: That battle is deeply rooted in my memories and I know in reality war is far more cruel than that.

units.rawText: In my dreams, we experienced many crises, but my Commander always helped turn things around and guided things to a satisfactory conclusion.

units.rawText: I tried to learn who they were many times, but it was only until I saw you in the Oasis that I realized where the sense of security in my dream came from.

units.rawText: Her direct statement pierces my disguise and I am caught off guard for a moment. After I come to my senses, I realize she's talking about my persona within the memory domain and thus, I proudly admit it.

units.rawText: Because of your existence, the course of the dream was changed. All the ominous feelings and unknowns were proof that you saved me over and over again.

units.rawText: Thank you, Commander. Thank you for completing my memories and thank you for pulling me back from the brink of a neural cloud collapse.

spans.text: Thank you, Commander. Thank you for completing my memories and thank you for pulling me back from the brink of a neural cloud collapse.

units.rawText: Oh, it's nothing. I told you before, right? If it's within my power, I won't abandon any of you.
